notes: Effective: Convention Art. 28 - India for assessment years commencing on/after 1 April 1983, Mauritius from 1 July 1983. Protocol 2016 (signed 2016-05-10, in force 2016-07-19) Art. 9(2): interest/FTS changes effective India for income derived in fiscal years beginning on/after 1 April 2017 (Mauritius 1 July 2017). Before 2017-04-01 the Convention allowed source taxation of interest without a cap (except exemptions). Interest exemptions not modelled: Art. 11(3) government/local authority/government agencies; Art. 11(3A) banks resident in the other State carrying on bona fide banking business, only for debt-claims existing on or before 31 March 2017 (old Art. 11(3)(c) bank exemption deleted); Art. 11(4) government-approved transactions. Art. 10(3): Mauritius-source dividends may be taxed in Mauritius only while dividends are deductible for Mauritian companies, capped at the Mauritius tax rate on the payer's profits - not modelled. Royalties 15% includes equipment rental. Fees for technical services: new Art. 12A (Protocol 2016) - 10% cap, from 2017-04-01 (not modelled as royalty). Anti-abuse: Art. 27A (Protocol 2016) limitation of benefits applies only to the capital-gains relief in Art. 13(3B). MLI: India lists Mauritius but Mauritius did not list India -> not covered, no PPT. Second Protocol signed 2024-03-07 (incl. principal purpose test) is NOT in force: Mauritius enacted it as Third Schedule by GN 136 of 2026 (Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (India) (Amendment) Regulations 2026, made 29 July 2026), but reg. 6 provides it 'shall come into operation on such date as the Minister may specify in a notice to be published in the Gazette' (https://www.mra.mu/download/GN136_2026India.pdf); no Indian notification found. No MFN clause on WHT rates.
